messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD##47621 - inference-queue-depth > 2500 (cell: eu-west-1a). Autoscaler not keeping up, sustained queue growth for 6m. Potential customer latency/failed requests. link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/47621

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered P1 -> paging on-call rotation. Escalation level 1.

SARA (oncall): acked. Looking. :eyes:

mike: seeing same on metrics. queue_depth spike + worker CPU high. autoscaler recent scale events show failed node launches 3x in last 10m.

jen: any error reason from provisioner? last deploys ok?

mike: infra provider returning quota errors, e.g. "insufficient_quota: vcpu limit" in cloud-api. quick grep from controller logs:

```
I0321 10:04:12 autoscaler controller.go:421] scale attempt failed: provider error: quotaExceeded: Requested: 8, Available: 0
I0321 10:05:03 autoscaler controller.go:421] retrying scale after backoff
I0321 10:07:55 autoscaler controller.go:421] scale attempt failed: provider error: schedulingFailure
```

SARA (oncall): thanks. So autoscaler attempted but nodes didn't come up. For immediate mitigation can we drain-shed some non-critical work or route to fallback cell?

jen: fallback routing is healthy but capacity disparity may cause higher latency if we send all traffic. We should try manual spin-up in other pool + temporarily increase queue timeouts.

mike: I'm going to run manual spin-up on shared-pool eu-west-1b. Command: `redwoodctl capacity create --pool shared-pool-eu --count 4 --type g4dn`

ops-bot: Command queued: request id 86f2. Provisioner: creating 4 instances in pool shared-pool-eu.

SARA (oncall): I'm updating PD incident with customer impact note: "Increased generation latency and intermittent 503s noted for ~6m; mitigation in progress."

pagerduty-bot: PD incident updated by sara (oncall).

mike: provisioner logs show two VMs failed due to image-pull timeout, retrying.

jen: check autoscaler backoff window - if it is stuck in long backoff it won't try more. runbook suggests `kubectl edit cm autoscaler-config` -> reduce backoff temporarily to 15s.

SARA (oncall): I'm OK with short-lived change, postmortem will cover. mike, can you apply runbook step?

mike: applied. `kubectl patch deployment autoscaler --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"15s"}]'`

ops-bot: autoscaler config updated. Backoff window now 15s (ephemeral).

mike: manual capacity command now shows all 4 instances provisioning; cloud returned success for 3/4, last in progress.

SARA (oncall): routing rule: divert 20% to eu-west-1b to help with warmup. `route-config set-weight --from inference-api --to eu-west-1b=20`

jen: monitoring shows queue depth for eu-west-1a plateauing, eu-west-1b queue rising slightly. No customer-facing 5xx spike after route change.

mike: final node came up at +12m, kube join succeeded, autoscaler acknowledged nodes; controller logs show successful pod placement.

```
I0321 10:15:40 autoscaler controller.go:512] nodes joined: 4
I0321 10:16:01 autoscaler scheduler.go:298] pod placement available
```

SARA (oncall): queue draining now, depth down from 2700 -> 400 in 14m. Latency back to baseline. Updating PD: mitigation successful, continuing to monitor.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged and status set to 'mitigated' by sara (oncall).

mike: quick post-action notes: provider quota was near zero because ephemeral spot pool had scale-down earlier this morning; autoscaler backoff + image-pull flakiness made it worse.

jen: filing follow-up: increase reserved capacity for shared-pool-eu during business hours and add faster retry path for provider quota errors. I'll own postmortem.

SARA (oncall): assigning follow-up task: ENG-4621 (owner: jen) - autoscaler warmup/backoff hardening + fallback routing docs.

mike: closing loop with customer support: CS ticket #9982 updated, customers notified of transient latency.

SARA (oncall): thanks team. react :thumbsup: If anything starts to creep back up I'll re-open.

incident-bot: Thread closed by sara (oncall) after monitoring stable for 20m.
